visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a white sleeveless top, stands in a brightly lit indoor space with wooden shelves holding decorative items like a small cactus and crystals in the background. She holds a gold-colored tube of DHC sunscreen, pointing at it while her mouth moves in an animated fashion and her eyes look directly at the camera. Yellow and blue animated text overlays briefly pop onto the screen near her face. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the woman's forearm as she squeezes a dollop of white, creamy lotion from the gold tube onto her skin. Her hand with manicured pink nails spreads the lotion in a circular motion, showing the texture transforming into a watery, transparent film. The background is a soft-focus indoor environment with warm lighting. (3) The camera returns to a medium close-up of the woman applying the cream to her face. She has gold hair clips pinning back her hair. She uses her fingertips to blend the product into her cheeks and forehead, her skin looking increasingly moist and reflective. Text overlays saying "After" and "Before" appear on opposite sides of her face as she points to one side, showcasing the visual difference. (4) She holds a white tissue to her face and then pulls it away to show no residue, followed by rubbing her arm against a black Nike t-shirt draped over a mannequin. She gestures towards the black fabric to show the absence of white streaks. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout this demonstration phase. (5) The woman holds both the sunscreen tube and a small yellow bottle, smiling and speaking with high energy. Large text overlays appear on the bottom and sides of the screen, listing numbers, percentages, and dates in Traditional Chinese. She points to the products and the text as the video concludes, maintaining eye contact with the lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice narrates with high vocal arousal and a cheerful, friendly tone. The speech rate is moderately fast with expressive pitch variability. Underneath the voice, an upbeat acoustic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat and bright guitar strumming plays continuously. The ambient environment is a clean studio-like silence without noticeable background noise. (2) A distinct "whoosh" sound effect triggers a change in narration focus as she describes the product application. The vocal intensity is high-energy, and the BGM maintains a consistent major-mode tonality. Every few seconds, a light digital "pop" or "ding" sound effect aligns with the appearance of visual information, adding to the rhythmic editing. (3) The narrator's voice drops slightly in volume but retains a clear, articulated quality as she explains the test results. A subtle fabric rustling sound occurs when she interacts with the shirt, but it is secondary to the primary voice track. The music maintains a constant volume bed throughout this phase, providing a cohesive flow. (4) A more pronounced "ding" sound effect marks the successful conclusion of the cloth test. The speaker's intonation pattern features frequent rising contours to signal excitement and engagement. The BGM remains bright and percussive, with a moderate tempo around 110-120 BPM, driving the pacing of the narration. (5) In the final phase, the narrator's delivery becomes more assertive during the promotion. The vocal tone is professional yet persuasive. The acoustic music swells slightly during the brief silence before the final word and then fades out sharply at the end of the clip, marking a clean technical finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem/Need -> Product Introduction -> Application/Demonstration -> Performance Tests -> Promotion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for DHC's sunscreen product. It uses a high-energy, relatable influencer format to demonstrate the product's watery texture, transparency on the skin, and its effectiveness through various practical tests (tissue and black fabric). The ultimate goal is to drive sales by highlighting a limited-time 69% discount.
